svg.title: Request latency by model, JevBench and JF100
svg.desc: Box plots of per-request latency in milliseconds on one RTX 3090, log scale, for v19, b1, b2, e1a and e1b. JevBench v19 median 93 ms; JevBench b1 median 216 ms; JevBench b2 median 234 ms; JevBench e1a median 80 ms; JevBench e1b median 89 ms; JF100 v19 median 80 ms; JF100 b1 median 167 ms; JF100 b2 median 229 ms; JF100 e1a median 65 ms; JF100 e1b median 69 ms
svg.text: Per request, one RTX 3090 under WSL2, log scale. Box: quartiles · line: median · whiskers: 1.5 × IQR · dots: beyond.
JevBench· 230 tasks over HTTP, cold first request dropped

g.title: v19 on JevBench (n=230): min 85, Q1 90, median 93, Q3 104, p95 282, max 437 ms
b1 on JevBench (n=230): min 203, Q1 211, median 216, Q3 221, p95 344, max 552 ms
b2 on JevBench (n=230): min 216, Q1 228, median 234, Q3 255, p95 642, max 896 ms
e1a on JevBench (n=230): min 76, Q1 78, median 80, Q3 93, p95 347, max 513 ms
e1b on JevBench (n=230): min 84, Q1 87, median 89, Q3 98, p95 387, max 608 ms

svg.text: JF100· 300 requests, in process, warmed up

g.title: e1a on JF100 (n=300): min 62, Q1 64, median 65, Q3 66, p95 333, max 530 ms
e1b on JF100 (n=300): min 64, Q1 67, median 69, Q3 71, p95 374, max 558 ms

svg.text: T5Gemma 2: encoder-decoder from Gemma 3. T5Gemma 2B: the encoder of T5Gemma 2B-it UL2 (Gemma 2), decoder dropped.
e1b is hobson-bidi's reference. Numbers beside boxes are medians, in ms. Hover a box for its five-number summary.
